The issue contains a description marked between <issue> and </issue>.

Here is the issue:
Issue Title: [BUG] Structured output is not properly propagated in the graph

Description:
### Checks

- [x] I have updated to the lastest minor and patch version of Strands
- [x] I have checked the documentation and this is not expected behavior
- [x] I have searched [./issues](./issues?q=) and there are no duplicates of my issue

### Strands Version

1.21.0

### Python Version

3.12.11

### Operating System

Linux

### Installation Method

pip

### Steps to Reproduce

In scenarios where a node returns both `text` and `structured_output`

### Expected Behavior

Both `text` and `structured_output` should be forwarded to the next agent as input

### Actual Behavior

Only the text output is propagated

### Additional Context

_No response_

### Possible Solution

The relevant logic is here, where `str()` is called on `AgentResult`:

https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/318573d0618c283f6f16ace1117d5e3d76279568/src/strands/multiagent/graph.py#L1002-L1005



In `AgentResult.__str__`, the `structured_output` is ignored whenever `text` is present:


https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/4ba0b47b6322bc7a8b04763e1a4d8f402e4778db/src/strands/agent/agent_result.py#L37-L57


### Related Issues

https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/pull/1290

Here are the possible buggy locations collected by someone else. Each location contains the actual code snippet and the intended behavior of the code for resolving the issue. If there's no text content but structured output is present, it serializes 43 the structured output instead. 44 45 Returns: 46 The agent's last message as a string. 47 """ 48 content_array = self.message.get("content", []) 49 50 result = "" 51 for item in content_array: 52 if isinstance(item, dict): 53 if "text" in item: 54 result += item.get("text", "") + "\n" 55 elif "citationsContent" in item: 56 citations_block = item["citationsContent"] 57 if "content" in citations_block: 58 for content in citations_block["content"]: 59 if isinstance(content, dict) and "text" in content: 60 result += content.get("text", "") + "\n" 61 62 if not result and self.structured_output: 63 result = self.structured_output.model_dump_json() 64 65 return result Modify or supplement the __str__ method to ensure that structured_output is included or accessible during result propagation so that structured_output is not lost when text content is present.
